title: DoctorReport
description: The machine-readable readiness projection emitted by `doctor --json`. It is produced by meshcore's domain-free doctor primitives, so both applications emit the identical shape. Exit semantics are unchanged by the rendering: a report with ok=false still exits 3.

ok.description: the AND of every check's ok

name.description: human check name; stable enough to correlate across runs but NOT an enum — checks are composed per app

probe.description: true when the check came from an EXECUTED adapter probe rather than a static check. Present so a consumer can tell the two apart without pattern-matching the check name.

deep.description: true when the check came from a DEEP probe: one real, bounded model invocation in an isolated throwaway directory, which SPENT tokens. Deep implies probe. Only ever present when the operator passed --probe-deep.
